name: Spotify Web TV Mode
description: Enhanced Spotify Web Player with larger text and controls for TV

params.css: [class*='Banner'], [class*='upgrade'], [class*='premium'] { display: none !important; } [data-testid='tracklist-row'] span { font-size: 16px !important; } [data-testid='now-playing-widget'] { transform: scale(1.15) !important; transform-origin: bottom left !important; } .player-controls button { transform: scale(1.3) !important; } [class*='progress-bar'] { height: 6px !important; } h1, h2 { font-size: 28px !important; }
